commitResults.messageBody:
- Rename chatbot from Duke to Chre
- Update Chre.java to greet user and accept input
- Display ASCII banner, greeting prompt, and farewell message
- Update documentation to reflect new chatbot name
- Add Javadoc comments to meet quality standards

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-1: Add command echo and bye exit handler
commitResults.messageBody: Update the code to echo commands entered by the user, and exit when the user types the command bye

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-2: Refactor Chre into OOP architecture with Add and List commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Extract functionality into focused classes following OOP principles:
- TaskList: manages task storage and retrieval
- Parser: interprets user commands ("list", "bye", or add task)
- Ui: handles all user input/output (display, prompts, messages)
- Chre: now orchestrates these components cleanly

Benefits:
- Each class has a single, clear responsibility
- Easy to extend with new features (new commands, task properties)

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-3: Add ability to mark tasks as done
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce Task class to store completion status alongside task description:
- Task: encapsulates description and isDone status with getStatusString() for display
- TaskList: updated to manage Task objects with markTaskDone() and unmarkTaskDone()
- Parser: enhanced with getCommand() and getTaskIndex() for multi-word commands
- Ui: displays tasks with status [X] for done and [ ] for not done, with friendly feedback
- Chre: handles "mark N" and "unmark N" commands alongside existing commands

Features:
- Mark tasks as done with "mark" (shows [X] in list)
- Unmark tasks with "unmark" (shows [ ] in list)
- Parser now extracts both command and arguments separately

commitResults.messageTitle: Add SE-EDU Java Coding Standard to project guidelines
commitResults.messageBody:
Mandate the SE-EDU Java Coding Standard (intermediate level) for all code in this project:
- Package names: all lowercase
- Class/Enum names: PascalCase
- Variable names: camelCase
- Method names: verbs in camelCase
- Constants: SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE

Reference the Google Java Style Guide for topics not covered by SE-EDU standard.

This ensures consistent code quality and follows industry conventions for the entire project lifecycle.
